File Information
Collection: WoTA Term Project (Co-working Space Reservation)
Collection Description
2110503 Software Development Practice term project, group WOTA. Runs top to bottom in Postman Runner or Newman (`newman run WoTA_TermProject.postman_collection.json`). Every run registers fresh users, rooms and hospitals, so it can be repeated. Set the URL collection variable to your server (default http://localhost:5000). Folders 1-12 follow the official presentation steps (Project Timeslots 69 > instructions): register + validation check, log-in, view co-working spaces, create booking + invalid conditions, view, edit and delete own booking, log-out, admin log-in, and admin view, edit and delete any booking. Folders 13-16 demo the extra credits A1-A13 (folder 14 also shows that an admin cannot edit but can delete another user's review, A10) (A4, A6 and A7 are also checked in folders 3-7). Folder 17 checks admin management of co-working spaces, folder 18 the VacQ APIs kept from Assignment 7, and folder 19 cleans up.
